original_question: Debra ɛhwɛ nwowa dann ahwɛ sɛ nwowa dodoɔ ahe na ɛba da biara da. Na ohuu nwowa 30 a wofi nwowa dann wɔ nnɔnhwere 6 a edi kan, na afei ohu wɔn mu fa a wɔsan ba wɔ nnɔnhwere 6 a edi hɔ no. Ohu nwowa a na wɔn dodoɔ boro nea ohui kan no mmɔho 1/2 sɛ wofi nwowa no mu, na nwowa no tu firi mu san fi hɔ nnɔnhwere 6 a edi hɔ no. Ɛno akyi, ɔmo biara a na watwe ne ho ansa na ɔsan aba no san kɔ ɔfese no mu wɔ nnɔnhwere 6 a edi hɔ no. Nwowa dodoɔ ahe na Debra hui sɛ wɔasan aba atɛwee no mu wɔ nnɔnhwere 6 a etwaam mu?
